Plus the MEASURED RTOLCAP/RTOFFCAP reserve-supply cap (G1): cleared reserve bounded by the measured online-responsive capability, so the lumped total family prices the MEASURED reserve level on the published ORDC curve, and its balance dual is added post-solve as the additive RTORPA - ERCOT's actual pre-RTC+B price formation (RTSPP = SCED energy + ORDC(online reserves); product duals are MCPCs, never added to the energy price). The measured RTORDPA overlay (deployments) and the DAM-AS overlay (2024+ DA-priced acute days the RT-scored co-opt cannot form: ex-overlay 2024 tail 10/53) remain, per-column persisted for the one-event-one-channel audit. No adder/haircut tuned to any residual.
